# Collateral Management Policy
1.1 Purpose
This policy establishes the guidelines and requirements for managing collateral taken for loans and trades at [Organization Name]. The purpose is to ensure a consistent and controlled approach to collateral management that mitigates risks and protects the organization's interests.

1.2 Scope
This policy applies to all employees involved in the collateral management process, including front office, middle office, and legal/compliance functions. It covers the handling, valuation, and monitoring of collateral for all types of financial transactions.
2. Definitions
Collateral: Assets pledged by a borrower to secure a loan or trade.
Loan-to-Value (LTV) Ratio: The ratio of the loan amount to the value of the pledged collateral.
Risk Discount: A reduction in the recognized value of collateral to account for market, credit, or operational risks.

3.1 General Principles
All collateral taken by the organization must be properly evaluated, discounted, and monitored to mitigate risks. The appropriate level of risk discount will be determined by the Collateral Management Desk based on the type and quality of the collateral.
3.2 Specific Requirements
All exceptions to the collateral management requirements must be approved by the Collateral Management Desk and documented. Periodic reporting on collateral management activities will be provided to the Risk Management Committee on a quarterly basis.

4.1 Management Responsibilities
The Collateral Management Desk is responsible for evaluating, discounting, and monitoring all collateral taken by the organization. The Legal and Compliance functions will provide oversight and guidance on collateral-related matters.

4.2 Staff Responsibilities
All employees involved in collateral management activities must follow the procedures outlined in this policy and promptly escalate any issues or exceptions to the Collateral Management Desk.
6.1 Compliance Requirements
All employees must comply with the requirements of this Collateral Management Policy. Violations may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

6.2 Monitoring and Review
This policy will be reviewed annually by the Collateral Management Desk and the Risk Management Committee. Any updates or changes must be approved by the Executive Management team and communicated to all affected employees.
